_comment: A worked example for make-proposal.py: a made-up conference, so no name or number here is a real lead's. Copy it into the lead's own project folder (projects/<id>/proposals/, which stays local) and change the words. The pages print in the order they are listed here. Every date on the calendar is named outright or counted from event.start (`days_before`, `days_after`, `event`); move the event and --plan shows the calendar moved. `in` on a post names the smallest plan that has it. Pictures (cover.images, ready.items[].image, loop.examples[].image) are paths beside the spec; this example has none, so the cards show an empty panel. No prices: the owner keeps them out of the document (an option card takes `price` and `price_note` if one is ever wanted). `out` is relative to the spec; here it points into the repo's temp/.
title: A video campaign for DevDays 2027

cover.headline: A video campaign for DevDays 2027
cover.sub: Six weeks to June 10-11 in Amsterdam. Videos in your look, each tied to a date you already have.

ready.title: Three kinds of video, one look
ready.lead: Each one is made from your site, your speakers' photos and your logo.

items.name: Speaker card

items.name: Countdown
items.note: Days to go, what is waiting, and the ticket price. 26 seconds.

audience.proof_label: What your own page already shows
audience.takeaway_note: So the heart of the campaign is a video each speaker and partner will want to post themselves.
audience.sources: Sources: public LinkedIn and Instagram pages on the day of this proposal.

steps.name: They post it themselves

steps.name: New attendees and partners arrive

options.title: Three sizes of one campaign
options.lead: All three run to the conference on a calendar fixed at the start. Each one includes the one before.
options.advice: Twelve videos on the calendar and a card for every speaker: the card is what reaches the speakers' audiences. A if few hands can publish. C to give partners a video too.

A track and a partner video

items.name: C. Full

rows.name: LinkedIn · speakers' profiles

You send a fact or a link; the video is back within a day.
You say OK, or what to change.

The right to post them anywhere.
